summary: About half the surface matches the prototype closely (workspace context menu, session context menu grammar at the source level, footer settings/agents cells, topbar title/breadcrumb/blueprint-window wiring, files/console/obs toggles). The worst gaps: the New(+) session button skips the prototype's entire configuration modal and creates a blank session immediately (no title/blueprint/expert-pack/workspace picker, no create-workspace path even though POST /v1/workspaces exists); search is permanently disabled (onOpenSearch is never supplied); the hierarchy ribbon is hardcoded to a single 'main' tab and never reflects the live child-agent hierarchy the transcript is actively showing; and the topbar's cyan-accent language is inverted between the artifacts and ctx% controls. The currently-served localhost:4191 preview is a stale build (version marker v0.9.0+a9962ee6, a hash absent from this repo's git history) whose session context menu still shows the pre-#345/#346 six-item grammar (Rename/Fork/Export/Share/Pin/Delete) — findings about that menu are graded against the current source (Rail.tsx), which already matches the prototype's three-item grammar, per the task's own instruction that source is authoritative for exists/wired.

items.element: Search-sessions icon button in the rail heading
items.proto_truth: title 'Search sessions and workspaces'; opens the SEARCH MODAL — icon+placeholder input, live-filtered result rows (workspace-folder icon or chat icon, label, right-aligned meta), clicking a row navigates there
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/shell/Rail.tsx:283-291 (`disabled={!onOpenSearch}`); apps/web/src/session/SessionView.tsx never passes `onOpenSearch` to AppShell/Rail (grep for onOpenSearch across the file returns nothing) — the button is permanently disabled and no SearchModal component exists anywhere under apps/web/src (grep for SearchModal/search modal is empty)
items.backend_surface: unbacked — no dedicated search endpoint is needed (a client-side filter over the already-loaded session/workspace list would suffice, as the prototype's `searchRows` implies), but the UI was never built
items.fix_hint: Build a SearchModal component (kit Modal + text input + filtered list) and wire onOpenSearch from SessionView so the button becomes actionable.

items.element: New (+) session button in the rail heading
items.proto_truth: opens the 'NEW SESSION MODAL': '+ new' header, session/workspace segmented toggle, (session tab) title input placeholder 'untitled session' + AGENT BLUEPRINT dropdown + EXPERT PACK dropdown + WORKSPACE dropdown + orange 'CREATE SESSION' button; (workspace tab) NAME input placeholder 'e.g. ior-sweeps' + PATH input placeholder '/scratch/…' + 'browse…' button + orange 'CREATE WORKSPACE' button. Hover on the icon is cyan (color var(--t-cy), border var(--t-cy4)), distinct from the neutral hover on Search.
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/shell/Rail.tsx:292-300 button calls `newSession?.()` directly with no args; apps/web/src/session/SessionView.tsx:481-508 `createAndSelectSession`/`startNewSession` call `client.createSession(...)` immediately with no title/blueprint/expert-pack/workspace input — SessionView.tsx never imports kit's Modal (grep for 'Modal' in the file returns only the Icon/Layer import line 23), so no NewSessionModal exists; live-measured hover on the '+' button: color rgb(221,225,232) / background rgb(31,35,43) (the shared neutral `--t-hv` hover from apps/web/src/shell/rail.css:62-65), not the prototype's cyan; apps/web/screenshots/visual-check/proto-new-session.png and apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/proto-new-workspace-tab.png are the prototype's two tab states
items.backend_surface: POST /v1/sessions exists and is called blind (apps/core/src/client/session_records_client.ts:41); POST /v1/workspaces (createWorkspace) exists in apps/core/src/client/workspace_client.ts:59-65 but is never called anywhere under apps/web/src — the workspace-creation half of this control has a ready backend and zero client UI
items.fix_hint: Build the New-session modal (session/workspace tabs, the four session fields, the two workspace fields) and route 'create session' through it instead of calling createSession on click; give the icon its own cyan hover treatment distinct from Search.

items.element: Hierarchy ribbon (row directly under the topbar)
items.proto_truth: data-driven breadcrumb of the currently-focused agent hierarchy (`{{ ribbon }}` sc-for): starts at 'main', gains a hop for each child agent the user has navigated into (e.g. 'main › geospatial'), the active/live hop shows a small orange pulsing dot, each hop is clickable to jump back
items.app_evidence: apps/web/src/session/SessionView.tsx:712 hardcodes `ribbon={[{ id: 'main', label: 'main' }]}` — no code path anywhere in the file ever adds a second entry or calls setActiveScope with anything but 'main' from a ribbon click; live-verified against a REAL running session with an active `Call(geospatial)` child turn (apps/web/screenshots/conformance-audit/app-session-selected-full.png) — the transcript shows exactly the kind of child call the ribbon should expose, but the ribbon strip still renders only 'main'
items.backend_surface: the session/turn data needed (child session ids, live status) is already reachable via the same GET /v1/sessions/{id} + turn data the transcript itself renders from — this is a client wiring gap, not a missing endpoint
items.fix_hint: Populate `ribbon` from the child-agent navigation stack (push a hop when a Call(...) block is followed, pop on back-navigation) and give the active hop the live-pulse treatment.
